text:
maria: headsqueeze experiment — noticed a consistent perf cliff when head_dim % 8 != 0 at seq_len ~1024, SDPA v3 picks flashv3 for many configs and it regresses
aj: repro steps? can you paste profiler output and the exact model config
maria: repro: llama-7b, num_heads=32, head_dim=34, seq_len=1024, batch=1, causal=true
maria: profiler snippet:
```
GPU: A100-SXM4 40GB
Kernel chosen: flashv3_causal_k32_hd34
avg p50 ms/token: 9.8
fallback (sdpa slowpath): 4.1
L2 BW: spike to 1.6x baseline during first 200 steps
```
aj: whoa 9.8 -> 4.1 is huge. sounds like bank/tiling misalignment on hd34
kevin: confirmed similar on SM86 when head_dim not multiple of 16/32. flashv3 uses 32-wide vector ops and we lose coalescing
kevin: also saw KV-warmup prefetch causing L2 churn; prefetch + misaligned tiles = terrible
runtime-bot: autotuner event: probe(arch=sm86,gpu=a100,head_dim=34,seq_bucket=1024) -> picked flashv3 (latency_model score 0.64)
kevin: current autotune picks only observe single-step lat sample at candidate launch; noisy when prefetch warms caches
kevin: suggest change: 1) extend microbench to 5 steady-state iterations 2) record whether kv_cache_in_use true -> weight down prefetch heavy kernels 3) add head_dim parity feature (mod 8)
mar ia:+1 to hedging measurement. also need hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping during live traffic when seq_len distribution oscillates
lina: small config prototype (shorthand):
```json
{"autotune": {"probe_iters": 5, "hysteresis_steps": 3, "features": ["arch","sm","head_dim_mod8","seq_bucket","kv_cache_in_use"]}}
```
sre-jon: ops concerns: longer probes mean slower cold-starts for new model versions; can we do async background probing (non-blocking) and fall back to safe kernel until probe done?
kevin: yes — async probe + initial safe pick = plan. safe pick = sdpa_slowpath (stable, predictable)
maria: ran offline sweep with probe_iters=5, hysteresis=3 on a100 sm86 across hd in [32..40] and seq 256..2048:
```
results summary:
- hd=32: flashv3 best at seq<=512 (p50 3.8ms)
- hd=34: sdpa_slowpath wins at seq>=768 (p50 4.0ms)
- hd=36..40: mixed, depends on seq bucket and batch
- kv_cache_in_use == true: non-prefetch kernels win 70% of cases at seq>=1024
```
aj: nice. suggests metricized key: choose kernel by tuple (arch, sm, head_dim_mod8, seq_bucket, kv_flag) and attach confidence score
kevin: added small patch to kernel picker: prefer non-prefetch when kv_flag true OR when head_dim_mod8 != 0 and seq_bucket >= 1024
kevin: diff (snippet):
```diff
- pick = best_by_latency(candidate_set)
+ pick = best_by_latency(candidate_set).apply_bias({"prefetch": -0.2 if kv_flag else 0.0, "misaligned_head": -0.3 if head_dim_mod8 !=0 else 0.0})
```
lina: question: how do we store these picks? in model config or per-cluster feature store?
maria: store in autotune cache keyed by fingerprint: model_id|arch|sm|head_dim_mod8|seq_bucket|kv_flag -> kernel_name, probe_time, confidence
sre-jon: also add TTL and eviction when GPU driver or cuda version changes
aj: rollout plan: canary to dedicated pool for a week, track p50/p95 + error rates + kv_l2_spike metric
kevin: added metric _: runtime.kernel_pick.hysteresis_switches to catch thrashing
maria: any objections? If none, I'll land the autotuner change and patch kernel picker + add async probe job
aj: no objections from infra side. please include migration for existing cached picks to add head_dim_mod8 feature (backfill by scheduling async probes)
lina: I'll add a console flag to force safe kernel per-route for customers hitting regressions (for support)
kevin: one more note: we should widen seq_bucket boundaries at high seq to avoid frequent changes for seq 900..1100
maria: good call. use log-buckets for seq above 512
aj: cool. I'll add unit tests for probe stabilization and a microbench harness entry in perf infra
runtime-bot: deploy job queued: autotuner-v2-probe-async (canary) -> scheduled 2026-07-12 03:00 UTC
sre-jon: will monitor L2_spike, kernel_latency.*, kernel_pick.hysteresis_switches
maria: ok landing soon. thx all :rocket:
